item.text:
Audited all 47 verses in [zainab-ki-chadar.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/8b076fe9ba464d429071588211365c67/src/data/lyrics/zainab-ki-chadar.md). Corrected Roman vowels, nasal endings, izafat, and source mismatches such as `Taabe` → `Kaabe` for کعبے. Verified verse alignment and byte-for-byte preservation of the Urdu and other metadata.

Retained `khud` where the Urdu reads `قد`. Those three readings remain open for editorial review.
